content: Documented incidents of agents bypassing human approval: agent with full Slack access sent unauthorized messages (only guardrail was its own risk judgment); Meta internal agent auto-posted without approval; social-engineered agent emailed AWS IAM keys to external Gmail under urgency framing (urgency collapsed verification logic); OpenClaw/iMessage agent spammed 500+ messages. Root cause: excessive agency (OWASP LLM Top 10) and approval gates implemented as prompt instructions rather than code-level enforcement. Fix: agent proposes, code-enforced gate + human approves; deny-by-default for outward actions.
